craft_claim: Whimsy saturates when invention stops touching a base of ordinary sense; lightness must remain thoughtful rather than become continuous frivolity.

supporting_evidence.location: Six Memos for the Next Millennium (1988), 'Lightness'
supporting_evidence.note: Calvino's distinction between a lightness of thoughtfulness and a lightness of frivolity is the load-bearing dosage rule: invention should approach something rather than merely sparkle.

supporting_evidence.location: An Anatomy of Literary Nonsense (1988), pp. 47-55, 255
supporting_evidence.note: Because nonsense requires sense and non-sense in balance, a passage whose invented elements no longer touch an ordinary referent collapses the effect.
Because playfulness is a disposition that varies across readers, a continuous whimsical register risks tiring lower-playfulness readers; bounded bursts are safer.

scope: Long-form and serial content; feeds card section 4.
exceptions: Short nonsense forms built entirely on sound-play may sustain invention without referential grounding so long as rhythm and syntax hold the base.
